note: Every quest the v2 board reports open at the frozen phase-4 baseline, with the classification that decides how it is re-expressed. A classification says what stands between the quest and a measurable v2 claim; it never reinterprets the claim. The acceptable semantic delta for the directly-expressible class is zero: structural change is fine, a weakened claim is not. No quest is classified blocked-by-action-authority: the owner repair is a prerequisite for all phase-4 execution rather than for any one quest. The closest case is restore-deterministic-cloud-gate-hosted-gate-repeatably-green, whose evidence can only exist after a publication, so it is the first quest that will exercise the new authority.

classes.directly-expressible: v2 can express the original claim and measure it as recorded; only the probe's form changes.
classes.requires-operator-seal: The owning epic carries no doneWhen and no authorizes, so nothing bounds a quest under it until the operator seals one.
classes.requires-missing-capability: The claim is expressible but something needed to measure it does not exist here: a scenario, a projector, a live environment, or an arranged condition.
classes.blocked-by-action-authority: The claim cannot be proved without performing an outward action, and doing so before the action-authority owner lands would exercise a known fail-open boundary.
